entities.name: Discovery of Koilos
entities.description: Event in the later Time of Legends when Urza, Tocasia and Mishra found the Thran ruins of Koilos.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A few crumbling buildings and caves holding the last Thran technology, remnant of Halcyon.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: Mythical beautiful capital of the Thran Empire.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: Ancient civilization whose technology remained at Koilos.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Archaeologist who claimed the Mightstone and killed the roc.

entities.name: Roc
entities.description: Bird that attacked the ornithopter and waited outside the cave.

entities.name: Hall of Tagsin
entities.description: Hall holding the large powerstone and a closed portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Powerstone
entities.description: Large powerstone split between Urza (Mightstone) and Mishra (Weakstone).

entities.name: Su-chi
entities.description: Constructs guarding the caves that attacked the explorers.

entities.name: Thran Spider
entities.description: Spidery construct Urza charged and used against the roc.

entities.name: Tocasia's Digsite
entities.description: Site to which the archaeologists returned.

events.summary: Urza, Tocasia and Mishra find the Koilos caves; a roc attacks, forcing them to land and flee inside.
events.quote: Underway, they were attacked by a roc , forcing them to land their craft in front of the cave opening and rush inside.

events.summary: They discover a large powerstone in the Hall of Tagsin; Urza and Mishra each claim half, the Mightstone and Weakstone.
events.quote: Urza and Mishra each claimed one half as theirs.

events.summary: They unwittingly open the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia and are attacked by su-chi, forcing them to flee; the portal closes on its own.
events.quote: they unwittingly opened the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia

events.summary: Urza mans the Thran Spider and sets the roc afire; it crashes onto the su-chi, smashing them.
events.quote: The burning bird crashed onto the scrambling su-chi, smashing them all to pieces.

events.summary: The archaeologists return to Tocasia's Digsite, Urza and Mishra arguing over who should own both pieces of the powerstone.
events.quote: Urza and Mishra arguing over who should own both pieces of the powerstone
